about: CANOPY write outcomes, one entry per WC6 row id. `detail` is the envelope detail and equals the toast for every server row; `<...>` marks the dynamic part (rows 6-9: OSPREY's message, row 11: the observed value, row 16a: the frame's `label`; a detail longer than `detail_max_chars` is cut at the last whitespace before that limit with … appended, so it never ends inside a word). `detail_cut_cases` are the cases that define that cut: `text` cut to `limit` characters is `expected`, a character being one Unicode code point. `default` is the detail used when a dynamic row has no message (16a: a null label). Rows 1-off-disabled, 1-off-origin, 3a and 6-readonly-run carry the 403 text of their cause in the writes cause table (`heartbeat_vectors.json` `writes_cases`) verbatim; 6-readonly-run is row 6 when the whole deployment runs read-only. `status`/`code` null: no response or no envelope. 16-coalesced: `outcome` is the winner's, no toast for the superseded value; `toast` is the viewer's text for a run stopped by it.
